title: How to quit 4D Server while running stored procedures

historical_commentary.text: Stored procedures were a headline feature of 4D Server v6, allowing server-side method execution in dedicated processes — a paradigm that remains central to 4D Server today, though the API and process management have evolved substantially. The need to gracefully shut down a server while stored procedures are running is still a real concern, but modern 4D Server versions provide more robust lifecycle management, including ON SERVER SHUTDOWN and preemptive process support introduced in v15+.
related_updates: 4D Server's stored procedure and process management APIs have been significantly modernized across v11 through v20+
Preemptive processes (v15+) changed the concurrency model; ON SERVER SHUTDOWN database method provides structured shutdown hooks
